edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender to owner, making the deployer privileged.
Ownable constructor writes the owner state variable.
renounceOwnership sets owner to address(0), disabling onlyOwner gates.
transferOwnership delegates privileged state change to _transferOwnership.
onlyOwnerOrSaleAgent compares msg.sender with saleAgent and owner.
saleAgent is read by the authorisation modifier.
addressToUnlock is the mapping key that bypasses transfer locks.
setSaleAgent changes the privileged saleAgent address.
newSaleAgnet parameter is assigned to saleAgent.
_amount is added to the recipient balance.
mint pushes new holders into tokenHolders.
mint requires mintingFinished to be false.
notLocked checks unlockedAddressesDuringITO[sender] to allow early transfers.
_from is the debited balance key in transferFrom.
transferFrom spends the allowance of msg.sender.
approve keys the allowance by msg.sender.
newToken parameter becomes the managed token.
mintTokens uses the token state variable.
tokens parameter is passed to token.mint.
to parameter is passed to token.mint.
setPercentRate writes the percentRate used in token math.
newPercentRate parameter is assigned to percentRate.
retrieveTokens performs an external ERC20 call.
anotherToken parameter becomes the external call target.
newWallet parameter is assigned to wallet.
fallback mints to msg.sender via mintTokensByETH.
fallback requires now >= start and now < endSaleDate().
fallback transfers msg.value to wallet before minting completes.
wallet state variable is the destination of the external ETH transfer.
fallback reads the start state variable.
mintTokensByETH is guarded by the hardcap modifier.
anonymous payable function delegates to fallback.
mintTokensExternal is restricted to directMintAgent or owner.
mintTokensByETH calls calculateTokens (overridden variant on the derived contract).
value parameter is added to invested.
newHardcap parameter is assigned to hardcap.
mintExtendedTokens computes allTokens with mul/div chain.
mintExtendedTokens reads percents for each wallet.
onlyOwner mintExtendedTokens calls mintTokens for each wallet.
removeMilestone uses totalPeriod.sub(milestone.period) and length-1 arithmetic.
insertMilestone shifts the array and inserts.
lastSaleDate performs unchecked start + totalPeriod * 1 days.
start parameter feeds the unchecked date arithmetic.
currentMilestone compares block.timestamp to milestone boundaries.
ITO.calculateTokens multiplies _invested by price and adds bonus.
withdraw transfers devLimit to the developer wallet.
devWallet receives the external dev fee transfer.
devFeePaid guards the one-time dev fee transfer.
withdraw requires msg.sender to be owner or devWallet.
withdraw forwards the contract balance to wallet.
to_updateBalance is the balances mapping key.
amount_updateBalance is added to the investor balance.
refund performs an external ETH transfer to msg.sender.
msg.sender is the recipient of the refund transfer.
refund requires refundOn to be true.
newSoftcap parameter is assigned to softcap.
newPeriod parameter is assigned to period.
finish calls withdraw on successful softcap.
finish rotates the sale agent via token.setSaleAgent.
PreITO.fallback depends on block.timestamp for the sale window.
Token.transfer passes the result into processCallback.
Token.transferFrom passes the result into processCallback.
processCallback invokes tokenFallback on a recipient-controlled contract.
registeredCallbacks gates whether the callback fires.
result flag must be true for the callback to run.
to determines the callback target address.
tokenFallback runs during transfer and can re-enter Token.transfer.
tokenFallback runs during transferFrom and can re-enter Token.transferFrom.
callback parameter becomes a registered callback key.
deploy hands contract ownership to a hardcoded manager.
deploy configures milestones on the ITO.
newNextSaleAgent parameter is assigned to nextSaleAgent.
addWallet stores the percent for the wallet.
wallet_addWallet is the percents mapping key.
setDirectMintAgent writes the privileged agent address.
newPrice parameter is assigned to price.
newStart parameter is assigned to start.
period_milestone is stored in the Milestone struct.
bonus_milestone is stored in the Milestone struct.
number_remove selects the milestone to delete.
numberAfter_insert is the array insertion position.
toArray_batch is iterated during batch minting.
amount_batch is minted to every address.
